body:
The goal of this PR is give us a better visibility of what failed during the CI tests.

To achieve this goal, the script has been split and some dead code was removed.

interesting behaviour here, the split test takes almost the same amount of time as the non-split one 😢

I couldn't find any way not to install yarn.

Even though the time is not decreasing, this PR provides 2 benefits:
 - better view of what's problematic
 - ability to restart part of the CI checks (looking at you functional tests)

Merge?
